title: Vibrant Argentinian Tofu Bake
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian dish that combines the flavors of Argentina with the convenience of a tofu bake. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together chimichurri sauce, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the sliced bell peppers, red onion, and garlic to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking sheet and spread out in a single layer.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the tofu is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
